messages.content: What is the best way to extract the unique elements from an array and return them sorted in ascending order? For a list of numbers 3 1 2 1 4 3

function.name: getUniqueSorted
function.description: This function takes an array of elements and returns a new array of unique elements sorted in ascending order. It does not require any additional parameters for sorting. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

array.description: The array from which to extract unique elements and sort them. This is JavaScript array type parameter in string representation. The list elements are of type integer; they are not in string representation.

message.content:
**Answer** Use a `Set` to remove duplicates and then sort the resulting values. ```js // Input array const arr = [3, 1, 2, 1, 4, 3]; // 1️⃣ Remove duplicates – a Set keeps only unique values const unique = [...new Set(arr)]; // 2️⃣ Sort the unique values in ascending order unique.sort((a, b) => a - b); console.log(unique); // → [1, 2, 3, 4] ``` ### Why this is the “best” approach | Step | Reason | |------|--------| | **Set** | • Built‑in, O(n) time, O(n) space.
• Handles all data types (numbers, strings, objects). | | **Spread operator (`...`)** | • Converts the Set back into an array in one line. | | **Array.prototype.sort** | • Native implementation, fast and stable in modern engines.
• Custom comparator `(a, b) => a - b` ensures numeric ascending order. | ### Complexity *Time*: O(n log n) – dominated by the sort step. *Space*: O(n) – for the Set and the new array. --- #### Using the provided tool If you prefer to let the tool do the work: ```json { "array": "[3, 1, 2, 1, 4, 3]" } ``` (Then call `functions.getUniqueSorted` with this JSON.)
